scope: personalrobotics/CCIL and its preserved forks. image_ccil is deferred.

label-filtering.description: Post-publication research: IROS changes, label-error filtering, action-chunking labels.

abhaybd-image.description: Fork-only early image-observation CCIL work, built on the fork's label-filtering.

dispositions.migrate: Carry into the unified repository after the normal milestone review.
dispositions.reconcile: Divergent implementations exist. Choose or merge them with experiment evidence; no version is canonical yet.
dispositions.evaluate: Exists only on a non-default branch. Decide whether it belongs in the unified repository.
dispositions.fix-then-migrate: Migrate only after the listed correctness or portability problems are resolved.
dispositions.deferred: Tied to image CCIL, deferred with image_ccil integration.
dispositions.archive-only: Keep recoverable through history and archive tags; do not migrate.
dispositions.exclude: Machine-specific, generated, or obsolete; do not migrate.

global_blockers.summary: No LICENSE file exists on any branch. setup.py declares license='MIT' and the GitHub API reports no license.
global_blockers.action: A maintainer confirms the intended license and adds a LICENSE file before any release (M6).

global_blockers.summary: No capability has a designated maintainer. Authors of record come from Git history and file headers only.
global_blockers.action: Assign maintainers per capability area as part of #9.

global_blockers.summary: No record says which branch or config produced each published result. The label-filtering commit 'Add changes from IROS' suggests IROS work, but that is unverified.

capabilities.name: Learned dynamics model (WorldModel, DynamicsNet)

implementations.difference: Adds local_lipschitz_coeff() and unreduced prediction errors.
Drops data-driven input normalization and exposes parameters() for joint training with the image encoder.

provenance.attribution: File header: 'Inspired by' mjrl; modified by Abhay Deshpande, Kay Ke, and Yunchu Zhang.

blockers: Confirm the mjrl license and whether attribution is sufficient for derived code.

capabilities.name: Lipschitz regularization variants for dynamics training

implementations.difference: lipschitz_type in {spectral_normalization, slack, spectral_normalization_slack, soft_sampling, soft_sampling_slack, soft_jac, none}.

capabilities.name: Spectral normalization with a configurable Lipschitz bound
blockers: Include the PyTorch BSD-3-Clause notice when redistributing.

capabilities.name: Corrective-label generation

implementations.difference: Types: forward_euler and backward_euler via root_finder_s, backward_euler_fast (alias random_backward), noisy_action, noisy_action_fe, backward_model, backward_expert.
forward_euler becomes fixed-point iteration instead of root finding; skips points where the model misfits (aug.model_err_thresh); records original actions.

blockers: backward_expert loads output/expert_policy/pendulum.pt and requires CUDA; that file is not in any preserved ref.

implementations.difference: Keeps labels whose state distance is below aug.epsilon.
Adds label-error estimate (local Lipschitz x distance), aug.label_err_quantile and aug.max_label_err, combined with epsilon.

capabilities.name: Corrective labels for action-chunking policies
blockers: The chunk_size branch is inverted: a configured value is ignored (8 is used), and an unset value yields None.

capabilities.name: Behavior cloning policy training (CustomBC on d3rlpy)

implementations.difference: Hard-codes loss weights and disables action scaling when env == 'tycho', an environment not defined in this repository.
Removes the tycho special case; adds configurable encoder layers and callable loss weights.

blockers: On label-filtering, CustomBCImpl always overwrites weight_losses with linear_weight_losses, so a callable loss_weights is ignored.

capabilities.name: NoiseBC baseline (policy.noise_bc)

implementations.difference: Adds noise_cov * torch.rand (uniform on [0, 1), non-negative) to observations for a random half of each batch. A commented-out dataset-level variant remains in utils.py.

blockers: The noise is uniform and non-negative rather than zero-mean. Confirm the intended noise model in M1 before using this as a baseline.

implementations.difference: data.data_frac selects a seeded subset of trajectories.

capabilities.name: Image state encoder for dynamics and policy
blockers: config/pendulum_img.yml expects data/pendulum_img_50_noised_fix.pkl, which is not in any preserved ref.

capabilities.name: Diffusion policy evaluation
blockers: The diffusion_policy dependency is not declared or pinned.

implementations.difference: Registers PendulumSwingupCont-v0 and PendulumSwingupDisc-v0.
Adds image observations (64x64 render) and PendulumSwingupContImg-v0.
